cases.refreshed: Join us for a monthly meetup designed for intermediate and advanced photographers hosted by Matthew Tw Huang. Whether you're into portrait, landscape, or any other type of photography, all are welcome! Each session will feature discussions on techniques, tips for improving your craft, and other aspects of photography. Ideas for 5-10 min topics, photo stories, or presentations can be emailed to matthewtwhuang@gmail.com. There will be time for a couple of ideas to be presented at each meeting. The format will evolve based on your interests and feedback, creating a supportive and dynamic space for photographers to connect, learn, and grow.

cases.refreshed: Join us for playdates every Wednesday. Children can practice sharing, taking turns, imitating others at play, and focusing together on an activity. Caregivers get a chance to connect. Don't miss out on this chance to celebrate the joys of play while connecting with other families in the community. It's a wonderful way to learn through play and create lasting memories together! 1st Wednesday: Cars; 2nd Wednesday: Superhero Obstacle Course (ages 3-8); 3rd Wednesday: LEGO Duplo Blocks; 4th Wednesday: Cars; 5th Wednesday: LEGO Duplo Blocks. Recommended for children ages 2 to 6 years old.
